substantive_findings: The original has continuing council establishment, eight-office membership, advice/assistance to the Bank Board, coordinating forum, and Treasury administrative support. It contains no report deadline, sunset, completion event or independent post-termination directive.

FACA section3(2) excludes committees composed wholly of full-time Federal officers/employees. Every original roster seat is such a federal office. Section14 therefore supplies no two-year termination of this Council; no speculative renewal gap remains.

Bank Act sections4-5 create a distinct body corporate and five-person board. The corporate Bank continues until dissolved by Act of Congress. The Act does not create this eight-office Advisory Council. Bank borrowing/financing powers are independent statutory functions, not saved EO11782 Council functions.

The EO advice about administration of the Bank Act is not a delegation of a specific Bank statutory power. METHOD_STOP_02 calls for actual named statutory scope, supplied here, but no hypothetical review of every historical finance-law amendment is necessary absent a concrete counterlead.

PL96-88 section104 defines Secretary as Education. Section301 transfers specified education functions and HEW advisory committees primarily concerned with those functions; this Treasury-supported Bank-financing Council is neither such HEW committee nor a listed education program.

Section509 redesignates HEW/HHS and deems references to HEW to apply to HHS, except transferred functions. This council seat continues by redesignation; it does not end on the reorganization date. Section505 preserves transferred-function orders according to their terms rather than automatically terminating them.
EO12212 explicitly makes the Act effective May4,1980, not its May2 signature. It supplies the succession date, not an earlier first end of the council or seat.

Full EO12379 revokes EO11782 in section15 effective August17,1982 without deferred terms or target saving. Its general inactive-or-no-longer-necessary recital does not itself establish earlier legal cessation; original continuing mandates do not lapse merely for inactivity.
EO13829 creates a separate 2018 Postal Task Force and assigns Bank support. It does not continue or revive the EO11782 Council.

Within the bounded actual-source record, August17,1982 is supportable as the first legal end of the five original units, after resolving FACA and HEW scope; no prior legal termination or specific saved Council mandate was located.
